thesisQuality.note: Recurring cloud security/exposure management addresses durable enterprise demand; 11% growth and platform expansion support fit while suite consolidation limits moat certainty.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 revenue grew 11% to $182.2M, GAAP gross margin 83%, adjusted EBITDA $83.8M and full-year guidance was raised.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: At $172.43 Sep.25, trailing P/E 29.93, forward P/E 21.47 and P/S 8.49 are demanding relative to roughly 10-11% revenue growth.

catalystScore.note: Raised guidance, AI-native Risk Operations Center adoption, federal pipeline and QFlex engagement provide identifiable catalysts with conversion uncertainty.

governancePower.note: Sequential guidance raises and sustained profitability support execution credibility without exceptional stewardship evidence.

alignment2036.note: Cyber exposure management, cloud security and security for AI address durable digital-infrastructure needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: One cloud platform spans asset, vulnerability, cloud, application, endpoint and compliance workflows.

bottleneckControl.note: Integrated visibility and remediation create workflow stickiness but broader security suites remain credible substitutes.

scenarioRobustness.note: Cloud-delivered security/compliance remains useful across varied enterprise scenarios; suite consolidation is the main concentration risk.

substitutionResilience.note: Platform depth creates moderate replacement barriers offset by credible endpoint/cloud/broader-suite alternatives.

supplyChainResilience.note: Cloud software has limited physical supply-chain exposure, with service/cloud dependencies remaining.

pricingPower.note: 83% GAAP gross margin and 46% adjusted EBITDA margin alongside double-digit growth provide strong value-capture evidence.

risk1.note: Moderate growth, suite consolidation and unproven retention/cross-sell durability can weaken differentiation despite strong profitability.

confidence.note: Fresh SEC/issuer results plus independent Sep.25 valuation cover core economics; retention/billings/win-loss remain undisclosed.

thesis: Qualys combines durable cyber-exposure demand with unusually strong software margins and improving 2026 execution, but moderate growth and suite consolidation cap moat and valuation upside.
keyRisk: Broader security platforms could compress retention, expansion or pricing before Qualys proves durable reacceleration.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 results and evidence federal, QFlex and AI-native Risk Operations Center pipeline converts into sustained growth.
